entities.text: High Court Of Judicature At Allahabad
entities.label: COURT

sentences.text:
Respondent :- State Of U.P. And 2 Others
Counsel for Petitioner :- Adya Prasad Tewari

Counsel for Respondent :- C.S.C.
Hon'ble Suneet Kumar,J.
Hon'ble Rajendra Kumar-IV,J.
Heard learned counsel for the parties.

Petitioner by the instant petition seeks the following relief:
"(a) issue a writ, order or direction in the nature of mandamus commanding the respondents especially the respondent no. 2 to ensure the payment of compensation to the petitioner along with interest under Right to Fair compensation and Transparency in Land Acquisition, Rehabilitation and Resettlement Act 2013 on account of acquisition of Bhumidhari Plot nos. of the petitioner being Plot No. 995 area 0.599 hectare, plot no. 996 area 0.1500 hectare, plot no. 997 area 1.600 hectare and plot no. 998 area 0.1400 hectare situate at Village Nausad, Tappa: Ret, Pargana:
Haveli, Tehsil: Sadar, District Gorakhpur for constructing Dam adjacent to river Rapti as Nasad-Kalani Dam as early as possible within the time frame."

entities.text: Pushpa Mishra vs State Of U.P. And 2 Others
entities.label: PRECEDENT

sentences.text: Learned Standing Counsel submits that the third respondent shall consider the representation of the petitioner.

In view thereof, on consent, the writ petition is disposed of with a direction to the third respondent,
Executive Engineer Flood Division Indira Nagar, Gorakhpur, to consider and decide the representation of the petitioner, in accordance with law, by a reasoned and speaking order,
expeditiously preferably within twelve weeks from the date of receipt of certified copy of this order.
It is clarified that the Court has not considered the rival contention of the petitioner on merits.

Order Date :- 17.4.2023 K.K. Maurya  Pushpa Mishra vs State Of U.P. And 2 Others on 17 April, 2023 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/85835490/
